versions.changelog:
- Upgraded CLI dependency from @dlazy/cli@1.2.2 to @dlazy/cli@1.2.3 for improved compatibility.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md) to reflect the new CLI version.
- Removed legacy file: skill-card.md.

- Updated npm install and npx instructions to use the fixed @dlazy/cli@1.2.2 version for better stability.
- Changed metadata to pin CLI version to 1.2.2 instead of 'latest' throughout the documentation.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Minor documentation cleanups and formatting adjustments to improve clarity.

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No changes were made to skill functionality or the main documentation.
set Chinese display name for CN search
set Chinese display name for CN search

- Updated version to 1.3.0
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md

dlazy-veo-3-1-fast version 1.2.1

- Added a Chinese description in the main SKILL.md metadata for improved localization.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- Documentation updates in SKILL.md and SKILL-cn.md for clarity and consistency.

- CLI dependency updated to use @dlazy/cli@latest instead of a fixed version.
- Command options changed: "generation_mode" now supports "frames" and "extend" (instead of "frames" and "components"); corresponding parameter changes for video extension.
- New options for video input in extend mode and explicit duration settings; image component and related options removed from docs.
- Output example and API parameter documentation updated to reflect the above changes.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file from the project.
Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Updated usage documentation for the --generation_mode option to clarify parameter meanings (frames=Frames; components=Components).
- No functional or code changes; documentation refinement only.

- Added support for authentication using the new device-code login flow (`dlazy login`) for easier API key setup.
- Existing manual API key setting instructions moved to an alternative authentication section.
- No breaking changes to command usage or output; all user and agent flows unchanged except for improved authentication guidance.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Updated to version 1.0.2.
- Revised instructions for handling API key: agents should now save the API key directly after receiving it from the user.
- Minor clarifications to agent instructions for error handling and task resumption.
- Documentation improvements for clarity.

- Added a new "Authentication" section with clear instructions for obtaining and setting the dLazy API key.
- Updated CLI dependency to @dlazy/cli@1.0.6.
- Minor documentation improvements and clarifications in SKILL.md, SKILL-en.md, and SKILL-cn.md.

- Initial release of dlazy-veo-3.1-fast skill.
- Enables fast response and generation of short videos using Google Veo 3.1 Fast.
- Supports text-to-video and image-to-video generation with customizable options for size, resolution, frames, and components.
- Provides command usage examples and detailed error handling instructions.
- Includes critical agent instructions for managing insufficient balance or missing API key scenarios.
